description.en:
Bumi is Noetix Robotics' compact humanoid for interactive movement and consumer-facing experiences. The manufacturer lists a height of 98 cm, a mass of 17 kg and 21 degrees of freedom, with articulated arms, legs and waist supporting gestures, walking and dance routines.

Users can control the robot through voice commands and a companion app. A quick-release battery supports recharging, while synchronized multi-robot dancing is offered through a separately purchased group-control option. Bumi's design emphasizes accessible operation and expressive behavior in a small body. Runtime and motion performance depend on the activity, and optional functions should be checked against the selected package.
